proof_attempt_summary: Discovery derived observable-law-indexed assignment and mechanism fibers, sharp marginal target sets, and statistical certificates; the Lean run closed the paper-owned proofs without custom axioms or placeholders. A final source audit repaired model identity and the fixed-assignment completion slice, but D0.5 graded the resulting package subfield, below the standing field floor. The bank preserves the sound result and its proof artifacts for a future higher-value extension.
tldr: The observable count-offset law tuple is the input to the identification result: offset-adjusted factorial moments recover \(\mu_m,V_m\), differences recover \(D\), projective reduction recovers \(V\), and the explicit final map returns the exact law-indexed structural fiber \(\Theta(V)=(\mathfrak F(V),\mathfrak B(V),\mathfrak A(V))\). Every member has a strictly positive same-observable-law witness. Frozen peeling computes sharp marginal target sets, while duplicates add no population information and label identification can occur without mechanism identification. In the full-cover atomic model, \(a>2\epsilon\) is the sharp deterministic threshold for a correct-or-abstain exact bijective-label certificate; the per-environment order \(\log p/a^2\) is minimax only for simultaneous recovery of all labels, with the converse proved on the unit-offset \(A=0\) Gaussian--Poisson permutation subclass for fixed \(\ell\) and \(v\). Under incomplete coverage, \(\sqrt{\log p/n}\) is the support-margin scale separating simultaneous exact recovery of all sharp marginal target sets on the declared \(\beta\)-separated class from impossibility of uniformly honest singleton reporting near the specified duplicate baseline. That incomplete-cover claim imposes the declared coordinatewise support margin; it imposes no additional vector-norm or projective-gap condition. Neither statistical result is a minimax rate or sharp frontier for recovery of the full structural fiber, \(B\), \(A\), or individual coefficients.
gap: Zhang and Li recover all coefficients when every node is covered and target labels are supplied. The closest mixing-matrix equivalence results begin from separability and faithfulness, while LIT uses recovered exogenous-noise information. None characterizes unlabeled missing-column count shifts when total effects may cancel and covariances may be correlated and environment-specific.
fill: The project supplies an if-and-only-if compatibility theorem, a count-law-functional constructive converse using corrected offset-adjusted cross-factorial covariances, polynomial sharp marginal target sets, an affine completion parameterization, an exact duplicate-invariance result, and a sharp correct-or-abstain statistical certificate.
